description: Master timeline for Dhurandhar universe — real-world anchor events (1999-2026) with film creative liberties noted. Covers Parts 1-4 and expanded universe.

events.film_relevance: Film 1 opening; establishes terror infrastructure release

events.film_relevance: Context for institutionalized ISI-terror nexus; Nawab Shafiq weakened

events.film_relevance: Context for Indo-Pak military tension; Nawaz Sharif unaware initially

events.film_relevance: Limited justice; planners remain protected

events.film_relevance: Lyari criminal warfare escalation; Jamali hedging failure

events.film_relevance: SP Aslam character arc end; Karachi police vulnerability

events.film_relevance: Lyari criminal consolidation under Uzair

events.real_world: Altaf Khanani arrested; KKI designated 'significant transnational criminal organization'
events.film_relevance: Financial network disruption; Khanani Javed continues

events.real_world: India demonetises ₹500 and ₹1000 notes at 8 PM; 86% currency value voided
events.film_relevance: Dhurandhar 2 climax; kinetic financial strike on FICN/narco networks

events.real_world: Javed Khanani dies (natural/assassinated/suicide disputed); 26 days post-demonetisation
events.film_relevance: Demonetisation impact; network decapitation

events.real_world: Financial Action Task Force places Pakistan on grey list; pressure on terror financing
events.film_relevance: Context for Sajid Mir 'resurrection'

events.real_world: Altaf Khanani released after extradition; network rebuilds
events.film_relevance: Resilience of financial infrastructure

events.film_relevance: Long-delayed justice; cyclical revenge closure

events.real_world: Sajid Mir sentenced (FATF pressure) after years of Pakistan claiming he was dead
events.film_relevance: Phantom handler finally produced

events.real_world: Hizbul commander Burhan Wani (22) killed in Kokernag encounter; 90+ civilian deaths, 15,000+ pellet gun injuries in 7-month unrest; 100+ youths join militancy; intelligence gathering suffers temporary collapse
events.film_relevance: Part 3 opening: Radicalization backdrop; youth militancy surge; TRF precursor cells formed
events.intelligence_significance: ISI exploitation of martyrdom narrative creates next-generation militant cohort; social-media-driven leaderless radicalisation not modelled by RAW; direct pipeline to TRF (formed October 2019)

events.real_world: 4 JeM fedayeen in Indian Army uniforms storm 12 Infantry Brigade HQ, Uri; 19 soldiers killed during battalion changeover; Pakistani GPS, food rations, medicines found on fedayeen; 2 Pakistani facilitators arrested by BSF
events.film_relevance: Part 3: Surgical strikes trigger; 10-day political clock; launchpad intelligence decision
events.intelligence_significance: JeM completes Gurdaspur-Pathankot-Uri pattern (state-sponsored escalatory signalling); intelligence held by embedded operative becomes surgical strike enabler vs. long-operation trade-off

events.real_world: Indian Para SF (Ghatak platoons of 6 Bihar, 10 Dogra) cross LoC; 7 launchpads across 4 PoK sectors struck; 35-50 militants killed (est.); Pakistan denies; DGMO announces publicly Sept 29 — first acknowledged cross-LoC ground operation since 1971
events.film_relevance: Part 3 first-act climax; punitive deterrence doctrine established; cover-blown operative survival crisis
events.intelligence_significance: India's strategic restraint doctrine abandoned; operative faces maximum exposure risk in ISI post-strike source hunt; launchpad reconstruction begins under new OPSEC within weeks

events.real_world: PLA begins road construction on Doklam plateau (Bhutanese territory) toward Jampheri Ridge overlooking Siliguri Corridor; India intervenes under India-Bhutan treaty; 73-day eyeball-to-eyeball standoff; NSA Doval visits Beijing July 2017; both sides withdraw August 28
events.film_relevance: Part 3: China as emerging second-front adversary; ISI-PLA coordination question; Galwan strategic prelude
events.intelligence_significance: First India-China military standoff since 1987; Siliguri Corridor existential stakes; ISI simultaneously probing Kashmir distraction window; CPEC as intelligence-sharing channel confirmed

events.real_world: JeM fedayeen attack Army family quarters at Sunjuwan Military Station, Jammu; 6 killed (3 soldiers, 1 family member, 2 militants); keeps JeM pattern active between Uri and Pulwama
events.film_relevance: Part 3: Sustained JeM threat continuity; Jammu as emerging theatre
events.intelligence_significance: Completes JeM escalation ladder: Gurdaspur→Pathankot→Uri→Sunjuwan→Pulwama; ISI maintains operational tempo despite post-Uri surgical strike deterrence

events.real_world: Adil Ahmad Dar (20, local Kashmiri, JeM-recruited 2018) drives 300-350kg IED Maruti Eeco into CRPF convoy bus 49 on NH-44, Lethapora; 40 CRPF killed; JeM claims; IP address of martyrdom video traced to Rawalpindi; India presents dossier to UNSC P5
events.film_relevance: Part 3: Balakot catalyst; Wani radicalisation pipeline's kinetic output; Rizwan launchpad intelligence decision
events.intelligence_significance: Pulwama = kinetic output of 2016 post-Wani radicalization; IP address to Rawalpindi provides dossier basis; 12-day window to Balakot; M4-carbine continuity thread to Reasi (2024) and Pahalgam (2025)

events.real_world: Operation Bandar: IAF Mirage 2000 aircraft strike Markaz Subhan Allah (JeM HQ), Balakot, KPK at 0330h; 1,000kg SPICE-2000 bombs; first Indian air strike on Pakistani territory since 1971; India claims 300+ killed; satellite imagery disputes building damage; PAF retaliates Feb 27
events.film_relevance: Part 3 centerpiece; air warfare spectacle; nuclear-threshold adjacency; escalation doctrine matured
events.intelligence_significance: Cover burned for embedded operative post-strike; ISI source hunt highest since 1971; deterrence signal achieved regardless of exact casualties; Balakot targeting package = culmination of years of ground intelligence

events.real_world: Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman (MiG-21 Bison) engages PAF F-16s post-Balakot; shoots down F-16 (AMRAAM serial evidence); his aircraft hit; ejects over PoK; captured by civilians then Pakistani Army; held 60 hours; released March 1 after US/Saudi pressure; nuclear signalling referenced in Pakistani statements
events.film_relevance: Part 3: Capture-return drama; nuclear threshold in real time; US/Saudi mediation as diplomatic instrument
events.intelligence_significance: 60-hour window: real nuclear threshold test between two nuclear-armed states; US Pence/Pompeo calls decisive; ISI exfil window for burned operatives; Pakistan chose de-escalation — doctrine lesson for Sindoor (2025)

events.real_world: Presidential Order revokes Article 370; J&K Reorganisation Act bifurcates state into J&K UT (legislature) and Ladakh UT; 35,000+ additional troops deployed under Amarnath Yatra cover; communication lockdown August 4 midnight; Omar Abdullah, Mehbooba Mufti, Farooq Abdullah detained; ISI had zero forewarning
events.film_relevance: Part 3 triumphal closer; Sanyal/Doval operational secrecy doctrine; ISI Kashmir narrative rendered structurally obsolete
events.intelligence_significance: ISI creates TRF (October 2019) in direct response — Khalistan-style proxy for FATF deniability; TRF's Pahalgam 2025 attack is ISI's long-cycle revenge for 370; longest internet shutdown in a democracy as security measure

events.real_world: Colonel Santosh Babu (CO, 16 Bihar) leads patrol to verify PLA withdrawal per June 6 agreement; PLA ambush with iron rods, barbed-wire clubs at Patrol Point 14; 20 Indian soldiers killed; PLA officially 4 killed (estimated 35-45); China suppresses casualties for 8 months; Colonel Qi Fabao (PLA) wounded
events.film_relevance: Part 4 opening; China as kinetic second adversary; Santosh Babu sacrifice; two-front threat confirmed
events.intelligence_significance: Pre-planned PLA ambush (improvised weapons prepared in advance) indicates theatre command authorisation minimum; China-Pakistan CPEC as intelligence coordination channel; ISI exploits distraction window simultaneously; Quad activated post-Galwan

events.real_world: Kabul falls in hours; 300,000-man ANA collapses; Ghani flees; US leaves $7B military equipment to Taliban; India evacuates from 4 consulates; $3B Indian investment (Salma Dam, Parliament, highways) under Taliban control; TTP attacks inside Pakistan: 300+ in 2021, escalating to 900+ in 2024
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Sanyal 'chickens coming home' monologue; ISI strategic depth realised but costs visible; Pakistan's western flank bleeds
events.intelligence_significance: RAW assessment of ANA timeline catastrophically wrong; ISI loses control of its Taliban 'strategic asset' to TTP blowback; India's quiet re-engagement with Taliban (2023) begins; CPEC-Taliban-ISI triangle creates new intelligence challenge

events.real_world: IAF Mi-17V5 crashes near Coonoor, Tamil Nadu; 13 of 14 killed including General Bipin Rawat (India's first CDS) and wife Madhulika; IAF inquiry: pilot error, controlled flight into terrain; India has no CDS for 3+ months; Theatrisation reform pauses; Group Captain Varun Singh survives crash, dies December 15
events.film_relevance: Part 4 emotional inflection; institutional setback at peak China-India LAC standoff; ISI information operations exploit sabotage narrative
events.intelligence_significance: 3-month CDS vacancy creates unified military perspective gap in ongoing LAC talks; ISI amplifies sabotage narrative; PLA extracts lac negotiation positions during vacuum; Theatrisation delay weakens India's two-front integration

events.event: Mystery Killings Pattern Begins — Zahoor Mistry
events.real_world: IC-814 hijacker Abdul Latif (Zahoor) Mistry shot dead at Crescent Furniture, Karachi; first of pattern — Guardian (April 2024) reports 'up to 20 assassinations since 2020' attributed to Indian government; subsequent: Sajid Mir (reportedly poisoned 2023), Paramjit Singh Panjwar (Lahore, May 2023), multiple Hizbul/JeM commanders 2023-2024; all using close-range gunfire, no attribution claimed
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Hamza's off-screen covert operations 2022-2024; systematic closure of Film 1-2 unresolved justice; ISI identifies pattern by mid-2023
events.intelligence_significance: Hamza's third cover identity; ISI partial profile by 2023 triggers maximum exposure risk; Five Eyes Canada-Nijjar revelation simultaneously blows India's global covert capability as intelligence theme

events.real_world: No-confidence vote 174-0; replaced by Shehbaz Sharif; Bajwa-military establishment withdraws support; Bajwa retires November 2022; General Asim Munir becomes COAS; Munir had been sacked as DG ISI by Imran 2019 (personal dispute) — sets stage for personal vendetta dynamic
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Civilian-military compact collapse; Munir as Film 4 adversary architect; Pakistan instability = escalation risk
events.intelligence_significance: Munir-Imran personal history makes Munir's Kashmir doctrine more aggressive (domestic legitimacy need); ISI operations continue at full capacity despite political chaos; NCA stability under military control

events.event: Imran Khan Arrested — May 9 Attacks on Military
events.real_world: Khan arrested at IHC on Al-Qadir Trust charges; PTI supporters storm Lahore Corps Commander residence, GHQ gates (Rawalpindi), air force bases; military declares attack on state; hundreds arrested including senior PTI leaders; unprecedented civilian assault on military property
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Pakistani internal collapse reaches military itself; Munir crackdown legitimises expanded military authority
events.intelligence_significance: Pakistani army absorbs all civilian functions post-May 9 crackdown; Munir's consolidated authority correlates to Pahalgam (April 2025) authorisation; Imran's intelligence from PM tenure becomes ISI leverage

events.real_world: Khalistan Commando Front leader Hardeep Singh Nijjar (45) shot dead in Surrey BC gurdwara parking lot; Trudeau tells Parliament September 18 'credible allegations' of Indian government role; GCHQ tipped Canada; 3 Canadian citizens of South Asian origin arrested; India expels 41 Canadian diplomats; ISI-Nijjar funding links (India's counter-narrative); RCMP confirms Indian government direction
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Khalistan arc from Part 2 reaches Western democratic soil; Five Eyes activated against India; ISI-Khalistan network exposure
events.intelligence_significance: GCHQ signals intelligence on Indian operations globally = catastrophic exposure risk for other programmes; ISI exploits Nijjar for maximum India-West diplomatic damage; Canada-India relationship worst since 1971

events.real_world: Two ISI-TRF-JeM joint cell terrorists ambush Hindu pilgrim bus from Shiv Khori temple on Pouni tehsil road, Reasi; M4 carbines + AK-47s; bus falls into Taryath gorge; 9 killed, 33 injured; attack on Modi 3.0 inauguration day (deliberate); one attacker captured (Pakistani national, Aaqib alias Mohammed Hassan); M4 pipeline traced — same arms route used in Pahalgam (2025)
events.film_relevance: Part 4: ISI Jammu pivot strategy post-Article 370; same M4 pipeline to Pahalgam; Modi 3.0 opening signal
events.intelligence_significance: Jammu division = ISI's new operational theatre post-Kashmir Valley security improvements; M4 carbine forensic continuity directly connects Reasi→Pahalgam; ISI-TRF-JeM three-actor joint cell model confirmed; captured attacker intelligence feeds Pahalgam investigation

events.real_world: 26/11 co-conspirator handed over by US after years of legal battles; NIA custody
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Closure beat; ties to Part 1's 26/11; justice delayed but delivered

events.real_world: TRF gunmen kill 26 tourists at Baisaran meadow; deadliest civilian attack since 26/11
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Opening tragedy; Sindoor catalyst; TRF white-collar terror

events.real_world: India puts 1960 treaty in abeyance; diplomatic act of war
events.film_relevance: Part 4: Pre-Sindoor diplomatic escalation

events.real_world: Indian strikes on 9 terror sites across Pakistan/PoK; largest aerial engagement in 50+ years; US-brokered ceasefire May 10
events.film_relevance: Part 4 climactic set-piece; title-justifying revenge; franchise culmination

events.real_world: Dr. Umar Un Nabi's JeM cell bombs Red Fort area; 15 killed; vengeance for Sindoor
events.film_relevance: Part 4 epilogue; grim reminder war continues; Part 5 setup

creative_liberties: Timeline compression: Hamza's infiltration (2001+) overlaps with events actually spanning decades
Character consolidation: Multiple real Lyari operatives consolidated into single figures (Shakeel Commando)
Demonetisation: Portrayed as targeted intelligence operation; actual policy had broader economic scope
26/11 Prevention: Hamza potentially could have gathered actionable intel; actual Indian intelligence was fragmented
Khanani Javed Death: Immediate post-demonetisation link implied causality; actual circumstances disputed
film_2_span: 2013-2022 (Pappu beheading through Mistry killing, Punjab arc, demonetisation)
film_3_span: 2016-2019 (Burhan Wani through Article 370; Surgical Strikes, Balakot, Abhinandan)
film_4_span: 2020-2025 (Galwan through Red Fort; Pahalgam, Sindoor, white-collar terror epilogue)
oracle_expansion: Parts 3-4 encyclopedia created for agent reference; real-world events 2016-2025 documented; 14 new post-Film-2 turning points generated with full internet scraping enrichment (Stage 2 complete)
